1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the page.
3: // Controls: Arrow keys to steer the ship.
4: // Collect fuel cells to extend timer; colliding with an asteroid or timer=0 ends the game.
5: 
6: (() => {
7:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
8:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
9:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
10:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
11:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
12: 
13:   // Game state
14:   const ship = { x: width / 2, y: height - 60, w: 30, h: 30, speed: 3 };
15:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false, ArrowUp: false, ArrowDown: false };
16:   let asteroids = [];
17:   let fuels = [];
18:   let timer = 30; // seconds
19:   let lastTime = performance.now();
20:   let spawnAsteroidCooldown = 0;
21:   let spawnFuelCooldown = 0;
22:   let gameOver = false;
23: 
24:   // Input handling
25:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true; });
26:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false; });
27: 
28:   function spawnAsteroid() {
29:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
30:     asteroids.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: 1 + Math.random() * 2 });
31:   }
32: 
33:   function spawnFuel() {
34:     const size = 15;
35:     fuels.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, r: size / 2, speed: 1.5 });
36:   }
37: 
38:   function rectIntersect(a, b) {
39:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
40:   }
41: 
42:   function circleRectIntersect(circle, rect) {
43:     const distX = Math.abs(circle.x - rect.x - rect.w / 2);
44:     const distY = Math.abs(circle.y - rect.y - rect.h / 2);
45:     if (distX > (rect.w / 2 + circle.r)) return false;
46:     if (distY > (rect.h / 2 + circle.r)) return false;
47:     if (distX <= (rect.w / 2)) return true;
48:     if (distY <= (rect.h / 2)) return true;
49:     const dx = distX - rect.w / 2;
50:     const dy = distY - rect.h / 2;
51:     return (dx * dx + dy * dy <= (circle.r * circle.r));
52:   }
53: 
54:   function update(dt) {
55:     if (gameOver) return;
56: 
57:     // Timer countdown
58:     timer -= dt / 1000;
59:     if (timer <= 0) { timer = 0; gameOver = true; }
60: 
61:     // Ship movement
62:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
63:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
64:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
65:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
66:     // Keep within bounds
67:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
68:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.h, ship.y));
69: 
70:     // Spawn asteroids
71:     spawnAsteroidCooldown -= dt;
72:     if (spawnAsteroidCooldown <= 0) { spawnAsteroid(); spawnAsteroidCooldown = 800; }
73:     // Spawn fuel cells
74:     spawnFuelCooldown -= dt;
75:     if (spawnFuelCooldown <= 0) { spawnFuel(); spawnFuelCooldown = 5000; }
76: 
77:     // Update asteroids
78:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.y += a.speed);
79:     asteroids = asteroids.filter(a => a.y < height);
80:     // Update fuels
81:     fuels.forEach(f => f.y += f.speed);
82:     fuels = fuels.filter(f => f.y < height);
83: 
84:     // Collision detection
85:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
86:       if (rectIntersect(ship, asteroids[i])) { gameOver = true; break; }
87:     }
88:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
89:       const fuel = fuels[i];
90:       if (circleRectIntersect({ x: fuel.x + fuel.r, y: fuel.y + fuel.r, r: fuel.r }, ship)) {
91:         timer = Math.min(60, timer + 5); // add 5 seconds, cap at 60
92:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
93:       }
94:     }
95:   }
96: 
97:   function draw() {
98:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
99:     // Ship (triangle)
100:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
101:     ctx.beginPath();
102:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
103:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
104:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
105:     ctx.closePath();
106:     ctx.fill();
107: 
108:     // Asteroids (gray)
109:     ctx.fillStyle = '#777';
110:     asteroids.forEach(a => ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.w, a.h));
111: 
112:     // Fuel cells (yellow circles)
113:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
114:     fuels.forEach(f => {
115:       ctx.beginPath();
116:       ctx.arc(f.x + f.r, f.y + f.r, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
117:       ctx.fill();
118:     });
119: 
120:     // Timer UI
121:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
122:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
123:     ctx.fillText('Time: ' + Math.ceil(timer), 10, 30);
124: 
125:     if (gameOver) {
126:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
127:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
128:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
129:       ctx.font = '40px sans-serif';
130:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
131:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
132:     }
133:   }
134: 
135:   function loop(timestamp) {
136:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
137:     lastTime = timestamp;
138:     update(dt);
139:     draw();
140:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
141:   }
142: 
143:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
144: })();

(End of file - total 144 lines)
